FACTORY IN MARI PHILAD ELPHIA WHERE RAIUM IS MANUFACTURED.

In the little town of Sellersville, Bucks County, Pennsylvania, about an hours ride from the City of Brotherly Love, there is located this plant, complete with the necessary equipment for the production ofadium. No secret is being made of the manufacture of this precious metal valued at $180,000 the gram, this week. P476/1 Carnotite ores, that hold the most valuable of the elements of Radium are being literally poured into the town. These ores come from the Green River section of Utah, from the Paradox Valley and other sections of Colorado where the Radium company has its several mining stations. Forty men are employed here in the product of all stages of concentration-the pure metal and the various salts used to carry it,the sulphates carbonates,chlorides and bromides. The company will not flood the market and the intention of the company is to furnish American Medical practitioners with radium in reasonably small quantities. Many foreign buyers have been sued the management of the factory and offered to buy the output for the $476/1 next three years, but the management has declined the offers.

RADIUM,-MOST PRECIOUS OF METALS,BEING
EXTRACTED FROM ARE FOUND IN U.S.

When Madam Curie, together with her husband, discovered Radium, an element possessing the property of giving off luminous actinic rays accompanied by heat without apparent loss of energy or weight,"they little dreamed that it would become one of the greatest aids in the cure of cancer. In the United States there are now two factories where Radium is extracted from pitchblende and from carnotite ore,the latter found in the Green River section of Utah,and the and the Paradox Valley and other sections of Colorado. The lower photo shows specimens of the carnotite ore.Hundred's of tons of this mineral is required for the production of a few milligrams of radium, valued at $180,000 the gram. The upper photo shows a view among the vats where the precious metal is precipitated and where the elimination of the sand, uranium and iron ore take place. 1/8/14.
